name: Cobalt
description: Pentest as a service platform. Monitor security assessments.

config.setupInstructions:
Cobalt's PtaaS v2 API requires TWO credentials.

Step 1 — Create an API Token (Authorization: Bearer)
1. Log in to Cobalt at https://app.cobalt.io
2. Go to your user menu > Settings > API Tokens
3. Click "Generate token", name it (e.g. "Comp AI"), and copy the token value

Step 2 — Get your Organization Token (X-Org-Token)
1. In Cobalt, go to Settings > Organization > API Tokens
2. Copy the Organization Token (a base64-looking string starting with "b3J...")

Step 3 — Paste both below.
Notes:
- Base URL is https://api.us.cobalt.io (not api.cobalt.io — that host returns 404).
- The user that owns the API token must be a member of the organization the Org Token refers to.
